No. That's a myth, and the opening line in this conversation ("the only human-made structure visible from the Moon") is false.

From the Moon (~384,000 km), no individual human-made structure is visible to the naked eye. The Wall is long but mostly under 10 meters wide, and it's built from local materials that blend into the terrain. Even from low Earth orbit (~400 km), it's hard to see unaided; astronauts, including China's Yang Liwei, have said they couldn't pick it out. Cities, airports, and greenhouses in Spain's Almería are easier to spot from orbit, and city lights are visible at night.
